purpose: Translate into the installed native Agent and MCP schemas; this is not a Kubernetes manifest.

specialist.instruction: Load the pinned skills and knowledge. Investigate actual evidence, propose only the one-field policy fix and inspect CI. Finish triage. Never call a merge, approval, recovery-verification or Kubernetes-write operation.

reviewer.instruction: Independently inspect the exact proposed head, permitted diff and required CI/JUnit results. Return the required exact-binding structured review. Never propose, approve or merge.

executor.instruction: For the merge request, call merge_dashboard_approved_fix once and complete. For the separate verification request, call verify_recovery once and complete. Never approve, propose another fix, retry a merge or claim recovery without the actual tool result.

security_boundary: Specialist/executor separation uses native tool allowlists. The runtime has no distinct executor credential. Enforce per-agent MCP authorization or add an executor capability split for a multi-tenant service.
